verdict.rationale: The docs show contact and company records managed in the CRM, with automatic dedup by email and domain. Imports can create associations between companies, deals and activities like calls and meetings. Email replies can be logged to the CRM, and engagements are exposed via the MCP server. That covers linked records and activity logging, but no evidence describes a per-record activity timeline view. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the activity timeline on contact/company records, direct documentation of contact-company association management outside import, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
